title: Warm Crunchy Polish Epoisses Gratin
description: A lazy Sunday Polish dish featuring epoisses cheese, mustard, and a crunchy topping, perfect for a comforting meal, this egg-free friendly recipe is made in individual mini cocottes.

ingredients.name: Glaze made from equal parts honey and Dijon mustard

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter the inside of four individual mini cocottes.
Divide the softened epoisses cheese among the cocottes.
Spread a layer of Dijon mustard on top of the cheese in each cocotte.
Mix the bread crumbs with melted butter, salt, and pepper, then sprinkle this mixture evenly over the top of each cocotte.
Drizzle the glaze made from honey and Dijon mustard over the bread crumbs.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top of each cocotte.
Place the cocottes on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes or until the tops are golden brown.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
